title: Understanding Model Variance
text: Model variance refers to how much the predictions for a given point vary between different realizations of the model. It is influenced by the complexity of the model.

title: Factors Affecting Model Variance
text: Consider how the size of the training set might affect the variance of the model. A larger training set can provide more information, potentially reducing variance.

title: Model Complexity and Variance
text: As model complexity increases, variance tends to increase. This is because more complex models can fit the training data more closely, leading to higher variability.
